demos.name: AI Policies LAB
demos.description: AI Policies, scope and HITL: four layered scope checks (surface, application, action, end user) read from a real RS256 token you mint locally, a third outcome that holds a call for a person, attended and unattended evaluation, single-use approvals bound to the exact call, and fail closed. A simulation of the 2026-11-02 Ping release claims. Mock tables, or a Live local engine. Every product claim is UNVERIFIED on our tenant.
demos.notes: Host-run: ./scripts/run.sh (port 7500). Docker: HOST_PORT=7500 docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only). Mock and Live are both loopback-only with zero outbound calls; the lab holds no credential for any real system.
